criterion_review.criterion: Both pin assertions belong to the current API SOURCE environment
criterion_review.assessment: The cold test imports real openai in a new subprocess using sys.executable, -I and -B; it does not select a legacy installed interpreter. The owner test imports openai in the API test process, replaces HTTPTransport with MockTransport, and loads only the selected run_model_test_request AST function from source. The exact 2.45.0 expectation matches the already reviewed current API manifest; requiring legacy 2.24.0 here would test the wrong environment. These are not installed-native requalification tests.

criterion_review.criterion: Preserve SOURCE controls and evidence boundaries
criterion_review.assessment: SourceOwner uses mock connections, in-memory records and a simulated transaction fence. The cold test retains a genuinely cold platform cache, exact audit-row qualification, foreign/argv/hold refusals and invalid-observation negatives. The owner cases retain intent-before-send, SENT ordering, immutable fixture hash, request mutations, deadline/Stop checks, output parsing, replay/foreign-owner denial, one-send accounting and frame-size assertions. Both version comparisons remain exact equality. No new skip, xfail, timeout, mock, fixture, guard or runtime change exists. Existing socket-detach skip logic is unchanged, and the recorded GREEN run skipped nothing.

criterion_review.criterion: Exact minimal delta with all tests retained
criterion_review.assessment: Programmatic Git-blob comparison confirmed that applying exactly the two specified pin/comment replacements reproduces the candidate byte-for-byte. Reversing only those replacements gives an identical whole-file AST. Both files contain 197 outer AST Assert nodes; decorators are identical. Original collect-before/after logs contain the same 135 unique IDs. Original GREEN JUnit contains those same 135 cases, including all 25 affected cases and 110 siblings. Historical integrations/hermes and api/tests/fixtures have no base-to-candidate diff.
